description: Add a --reverse flag to the small CLI in src/. The flag reverses the order of the lines the CLI prints. Implement parsing of --reverse in src/args.ts (parseArgs should set options.reverse to true when the flag is present, false otherwise) and reject unknown arguments with a descriptive error instead of silently ignoring them, then implement the reversing behavior in src/printer.ts (formatLines should reverse the lines when options.reverse is true). The tests in tests/printer.test.ts and tests/args.test.ts describe the exact expected behavior; the --reverse and unknown-argument tests currently fail. Make them pass while keeping the existing tests green.
